newsitem.title: RUSSIA: CentreInvest sees gains in Tatneft.
newsitem.headline: CentreInvest sees gains in Tatneft.

text.p: Shares in regional oil producer AO Tatneft, in which American Depositary Shares (ADSs) will debut on the London Stock Exchange on December 18, have the potential to rise strongly, CentreInvest Securities said on Tuesday.
"On the basis of conservative risk-adjusted fundamentals, Tatneft would be fairly valued at around $58 per share, near term," it said in a research note.
"Given the suspected over-subscription of approximately six times the ADS placement, appreciation from Tatneft's placement price of $45 per share is highly probable," it said.
CentreInvest used four valuation methods to rate Tatneft -- book value, reserves, production and cash flow.
The ADS issue, priced at $45 a share, comprised 2.33 million ADSs, each equivalent to one underlying share, and was significantly oversubscribed, the company said on Monday.

Tatneft, based in Russia's autonomous republic of Tatarstan, which owns 41 percent of the shares, is one of Russia's biggest oil producers, with output of about 25 million tonnes of crude in 1995, and proven reserves of 841 million tonnes.
